review_notes: Independently read all six proposed facts' canonical citations, the rendered owned header/source, and every upstream contradiction evidence range. All six changes are supported; functionality.md agrees with the proposal. Retain inherited supported knowledge unchanged. Accept deferrals for compiled layout, historical Coin Battle association, first-bit meaning, external resource lifetime, and foreign renderer binding; source alone cannot settle them.

proposed_facts.reason: Zero initialization, status writes, unsigned field widths, configuration stores and guarded counting support the corrected state behavior without making compiled-layout claims.

Configuration clamps before narrowing, stores X directly and negates signed Y. The regular-clear caller supplies coordinates, coins and interval five. The signed-minimum negation caveat is appropriate.
Canonical definition and declaration specify four integer parameters and void return; the body returns normally. Three-bit storage distinguishes requested cadence from effective cadence.

Unsigned three-bit conversion permits zero, including input eight. Decrement-before-test makes stored zero and one increment on each eligible invocation. The target has only an upper input clamp before unsigned-byte conversion.
All enabled visibility, countdown, translation and animation changes are inside current <= target. Equality preserves presentation updates without incrementing; current > target bypasses them.

The canonical routine loads the named Coin Get archive and constructs its scene. InitScene is a supported descriptive inference and resolves the independently observed rendered-header collision without asserting a recovered symbol.

contradictions.reason: Accept the four configuration/state supersessions: input bounds do not guarantee nonzero stored cadence or a stored target at most 100, and void does not mean noreturn. The proposal and functionality document preserve these distinctions.
Accept the callback supersession: an enabled invocation need not animate because the current-greater-than-target branch performs no presentation changes.

Accept the initializer-name supersession. Its archive/scene transaction supports InitScene independently of rendered hypotheses; the shared header contains the separate declaration involved in the observed name collision.

Accept deferral of all six compiled-section claims. The size assertion, ordering helper, pointer declarations, extern float and presentation expressions support source-level observations, not emitted extents, placement, conversion-bias entries or relocation bindings.

Accept unresolved dispositions for all eight mode-attribution facts and all eight links. Canonical numeric presentation, resource construction and regular-clear/results-player callers do not establish the historical Coin Battle-specific association. Broader usage does not disprove that association, so no link replacement or clearing is warranted.

Accept lifecycle deferral: the common cleanup caller invokes a two-bit reset, not local archive or GObj destruction. The first status bit's intended meaning and destruction ownership remain unestablished. Retain supported construction and deactivation knowledge without extending it into a cross-file lifetime guarantee.
